summary: Iranian hard-liners reportedly sabotaged a US-Iran peace deal by attacking commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz, deepening the power struggle in Tehran. IDF destroyed Hezbollah's underground compound at Ali Taher Ridge and prepares for control, while Hezbollah response and a multi-front scenario are feared. Houthi control of Bab al-Mandab and strikes on Saudi oil facilities in Jizan raise maritime and Gulf security alarms.
key_points: Iranian hard-liners orchestrated attack on three commercial ships in Strait of Hormuz, sabotaging US-Iran peace deal; Pezeshkian confronted Vahidi, traced to faction linked to Hossein Taeb (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7101).

IDF demolished Hezbollah underground tunnels at Ali Taher Ridge Thursday; Katz says ridge is part of Israel's 700 sq km security zone in Lebanon, IDF will not withdraw until Hezbollah disarmed (Source: @New_security8200/203787).

Houthis control Bab al-Mandab strait at 18km narrowest point; Israel raised navy alert as 98% of imports depend on sea lane; Yemeni gov forces withdrew from Perim island (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/391604).
Houthi missile attacks caused direct damage to oil facility in Jizan, Saudi Arabia; explosions also reported in Najran, Abha, Khamis Mushait (Source: @kianmeli1/91942).
Iran requested advanced Russian Geran drones from Moscow for war with Israel and US, per Financial Times citing officials (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7096).
IDF killed two Hamas engineering wing militants in Gaza: Mahmoud Hassan Ali Abu Nada and Abd al-Rahim Ahmad Khalil Hawar; precision munitions used (Source: @New_security8200/203783).
Multiple explosions and heavy fire hit Kurdish opposition opposition headquarters in Sulaymaniyah, northern Iraq; missile attack reported (Source: @naya_foriraq/90456).

sections.executive_summary: Iranian hard-liners sabotaged a US-Iran peace deal by attacking commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz, exposing a deep power struggle with President Pezeshkian and IRGC commander Vahidi. IDF destroyed Hezbollah's underground compound at Ali Taher Ridge and is preparing for control, while Hezbollah response and a multi-front scenario are feared across Lebanon. Houthi control of Bab al-Mandab and strikes on Saudi oil facilities in Jizan raise maritime and Gulf security alarms.

points: NYT reports Iranian hard-liners orchestrated attack on three commercial ships in Strait of Hormuz to sabotage US-Iran peace deal; President Pezeshkian learned of attack during July Iraq visit, angrily confronted IRGC commander Gen. In Hormuz framework, Iran's proposal for vessel fees widely rejected but readiness to examine voluntary payments in exchange for guiding ships through strait exists; Oman legal framework allows voluntary payments for navigation safety (Source: @SharghDaily/183563).

sections.threat_assessment: The sabotage of the US-Iran peace deal by IRGC hard-liners significantly raises escalation risk across multiple fronts. Iran's request for Russian Geran drones signals deepening Moscow-Tehran military cooperation against US and Israeli targets. Houthi control of Bab al-Mandab at the 18km narrowest point creates a credible maritime chokehold threatening 98% of Israeli imports. Hezbollah remains capable of multi-front retaliation after the Ali Taher Ridge demolition. The Sulaymaniyah attacks indicate ongoing instability in northern Iraq with potential to draw in regional actors.
sections.regional_response: Gulf Arab states are shifting toward negotiation with Tehran as an existential necessity after Trump declined Saudi requests for strikes on Houthis and economic pressure on Iran intensifies. Israel is preparing for a multi-front scenario with high IDF alert levels and operational readiness for Hezbollah response. Saudi Arabia has raised alerts across multiple locations including Abha emergency warning while Khamis Mushait danger passed. Yemeni government forces are conducting air operations against Houthi positions in Hilan mountains.
sections.intelligence_notes: A power struggle within Iran's leadership is the most significant internal development, with President Pezeshkian clashing with IRGC commander Vahidi over the Hormuz ship attacks. Hard-line faction linked to Hossein Taeb has gained the upper hand, undermining diplomatic channels. Russia-Iran drone cooperation is expanding with Iran seeking advanced Geran systems. US policy uncertainty under Trump, including resharing claims of Iran's economic desperation, adds unpredictability. The NYT reports Iranian officials confirmed the hard-line sabotage of peace negotiations.
